description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to runtime utility functions for Kubernetes kustomize kyaml, including function specifications, environment configurations, storage mounts, and resource filtering.

classes.name: ContainerNetworkName
classes.description: Type for network name used in containers, with constants for 'none' and 'host'.

classes.name: ContainerEnv
classes.description: Defines environment variables and exported keys for a container.

classes.name: FunctionSpec
classes.description: Specifies how to run a function, either as a container or executable.

classes.name: ExecSpec
classes.description: Specifies command path, arguments, and environment for executable functions.

classes.name: ContainerSpec
classes.description: Specifies container image, network, mounts, and environment variables.

classes.name: StorageMount
classes.description: Represents storage mount options for containers, including type, source, destination, and read/write mode.

classes.name: IsReconcilerFilter
classes.description: Resource filter to include or exclude reconcilers based on annotations or apiVersion prefixes.

methods.name: GetDockerFlags
methods.description: Returns docker run style environment flags based on ContainerEnv.

methods.name: AddKeyValue
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the container environment variables.

methods.name: HasExportedKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is marked for export in the environment.

methods.name: AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key to the list of exported environment variables.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Returns environment variables as a slice of strings in 'key=value' format.

methods.name: NewContainerEnv
methods.description: Creates a new ContainerEnv with default environment variables.

methods.name: NewContainerEnvFromStringSlice
methods.description: Creates a new ContainerEnv from a slice of environment strings.

methods.name: GetFunctionSpec
methods.description: Retrieves the FunctionSpec from a YAML node, checking annotations and legacy container annotation.

methods.name: getFunctionSpecFromAnnotation
methods.description: Parses FunctionSpec from resource annotations or metadata.

methods.name: StringToStorageMount
methods.description: Converts a string with comma-separated key=value pairs into a StorageMount object.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters resources based on whether they are reconcilers or not, according to filter settings.
